description: §14.8.9 RULING S443 #7 — a password-class derivation (`scrml:crypto` `hash("argon2", …)`) of a protected column is a value of independent identity and may be returned: no E-PROTECT-006.
rationale: RULING S443 #7 keeps keyed and password-class derivers (verifyPassword, verifyHash, keyed hmac, argon2) on the §14.8.9 deriver allowlist; only a bare digest was removed. The negative twin of protect-bare-digest-e006.
